Name: Nyapu for Miihaus Leah Events
Author: amillionand1fandoms
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]My quest to make all of the portraits in my modded game consistent continues. This is made much easier by the many people who make awesome Nyapu style portraits, but occasionally I come across portraits no one has done yet. So I made a quick mashup of several Nyapu portraits for this character that appears in Miihau's Leah Event Expansion. And I figured I'd share it so other people can benefit![/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8][size=3]This is a Content Patcher mod, so just put it in your mods folder.[/size][/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks so much to Nyapu for the open permissions that allow modders to create so many matching portraits![/color][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]Thanks to Miihau for all the awesome event expansions![/color][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]My Nyapu Style Portraits[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47343]Darker Demetrius[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255]Seasonal Nyapu[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47539]Nyapu Grandma[/url] to go with aedenthorn’s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47340]mod that replaces Grandpa with Grandma[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47630]Make Gunther Nyapu[/url] to go with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7102]Make Gunther Real[/url] 
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48980]Make Gil Nyapu[/url] to go with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7118]Make Gil Real[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47683]Nyapu Sevinae[/url] to go with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/22743]Alchemistry[/url]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48654]Art Teacher Portrait[/url] for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28299]Miihau’s Leah Event Expansion[/url][/color]
